Date: 2026-09-28

### MANUAL NOTES & TASK LOG:
- [09:30] Team standup and sprint backlog review.
- [10:15] Refactored user authentication middleware to support JWT refresh token rotation.
- [12:00] Reviewed PR #142 for the payment gateway webhook retry logic; left comments on error boundary handling.
- [14:00] Optimized database query in PostgreSQL for active subscription queries; lowered p99 latency from 420ms to 65ms using composite indexes.
- [16:30] Investigated intermittent timeout on Stripe webhook processing in production staging environment.
- [17:15] Blockers: Waiting on DevOps approval for new Redis caching cluster deployment to production.
- [17:45] Drafted technical documentation for the upcoming API v2 migration.
